definitions: To plant or re-plant (a plant) in a pot.
To shoot (an animal or bird) for food or sport.
To hit (a ball) into a pocket in billiards, snooker, or pool.
To preserve (food) in a pot or jar.
examples: She decided to pot the seedlings.
He will pot the jam later.
They went out to pot some pheasants.
He managed to pot the black ball.
She learned to pot her own herbs.
